## Summary

The `schema!` proc macro is a thin token→builder translator: it recognizes `doc`/node/mark blocks, emits a `Schema::builder()...build()` expression, and returns `Result<Schema, SchemaError>`. It supports no accessibility declarations, no typed accessors, and has no compile-fail tests. `Schema::full()` uses a11y, `Enum`/`List`/`Map` attrs, required attrs, and doc metadata that the macro cannot express. The documented gaps are already recorded in `DIVERGENCES.md:60` and `plan/04_arquitetura.md:41,56`, but `plan/04:694-696` is stale and README never mentions the macro.

## Supported grammar (exact)

| Block | Fields | Emitted builder calls | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `doc { ... }` | `content: "..."`, `attrs: { name: type [= literal], ... }` | `DocSpec::new().content(..).attr(..)` | `crates/rich-editor-auy-macros/src/lib.rs:87-103` |
| node `name { ... }` (any block without a `mark` entry) | `content: "..."`, `group: "..."`, `marks: "_" \| "all" \| "*"`, `inline: true/false`, `atom: true/false`, `defining: true/false`, `isolating: true/false`, `attrs: {...}` | `NodeSpec::new(name).content/.group/.marks_all/.inline/.atom/.defining/.isolating/.attr` | `lib.rs:106-159` |
| mark `name { mark, ... }` (recognized solely by presence of an entry named `mark`) | `mark` (no-op marker), `inclusive: bool`, `excludes: "..."`, `attrs: {...}` | `MarkSpec::new(name).inclusive/.excludes/.attr` | `lib.rs:162-184`; recognition `lib.rs:65-70` |
| attr entry | `str`, `bool`, `ref`, `any`, `int(min..=max)`, optional `= literal` (`"..."`, `true`/`false`, integer) | `AttrSpec::new(name, AttrType::…).with_default(..)` | `lib.rs:186-211`; `parse.rs:11-42,44-69` |

Expansion order is fixed: `.doc(...)` → all `.node(...)` in source order → all `.mark(...)` appended last → `.build()` (`lib.rs:76-84`). Declarations are classified as marks if *any* entry is named `mark` (`lib.rs:66`), so `strong { }` would be treated as a node and duplicate `doc` blocks silently replace earlier ones (`lib.rs:59-63`).

## Answers

### 1. Builder surface the macro does not reach

Builder methods (complete):

- `NodeSpec`: `new`, `content`, `group`, `inline`, `atom`, `defining`, `isolating`, `marks_all`, `attr`, `a11y` — `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/spec.rs:122,146,153,160,167,174,181,188,195,204`.
- `MarkSpec`: `new`, `inclusive`, `excludes`, `attr`, `a11y` — `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/mark.rs:33,51,58,65,74`. Note `MarkSpec.groups` exists (`mark.rs:16-17`) but **there is no `group()` setter at all**, so neither macro nor builder can set mark groups.
- `DocSpec`: `new`/`default`, `content`, `attr`, `a11y` — `spec.rs:221-228,234,240,247,256`.
- `AttrSpec`: `new`, `required`, `with_default` — `spec.rs:53,65,72`.
- `A11ySpec`: `new`, `with_name`, `with_alt`, `with_level`, `error_code` — `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/a11y/role.rs:153,168,175,182,189`.

Macro gaps versus builders/`full()`:
- `a11y(..)` on doc, node, mark: absent (`lib.rs:100,155,180` reject the field).
- `AttrSpec::required()`: no syntax (`lib.rs:186-211` cannot emit it); `full()` uses it on `alt`, `href`, `level` (`full/nodes.rs:36,187`; `full/marks.rs:44`).
- `AttrType::Enum`, `List`, `Map`: unsupported (`parse.rs:17-27`); `full()` uses them (`full/attrs.rs:34-48`, `full/nodes.rs:18-21,104-118`).
- Attr defaults only `Str`/`Bool`/`Int`; no `Null`, `Array`, `Map`, `Ref` defaults (`parse.rs:44-69`).
- No restricted mark sets: only `MarkMode::All`/`None` exist (`spec.rs:88-96,188-191`); `full()`'s `marks: "_"` maps to `marks_all()`.
- Multiple `group:` entries technically work (duplicate entries each push a group), but only one group is documented (`lib.rs:115-118`).
- Doc a11y override / name / description impossible; `DocSpec::default()` always supplies `A11yRole::Document` (`spec.rs:221-228`).

`Schema::full()` additionally declares a11y for nearly every node (`full/nodes.rs:17,26,40-44,53,64,71,78,88,100,115,122,128,141,156,163,170,192`) and marks (`full/marks.rs:17,46,52`), plus doc `lang`/`dir` as `Str`/`Enum` attrs (`full/attrs.rs:7-20`).

### 2. Typed accessors

None. The macro emits only the builder chain ending in `.build()` (`lib.rs:76-84`); the test types it as `Result<Schema, SchemaError>` (`tests/macro_schema.rs:9`). No node-kind, mark-id, or attr-name constants are emitted anywhere.

What typed accessors would require:
- `NodeKind(pub u16)` (`src/model/ids.rs:14`), `MarkId(pub u16)` (`ids.rs:26`), `AttrId(pub u16)` (`ids.rs:30`) are already const-constructible.
- Builder assigns node kinds by node declaration order (`builder.rs:80-83`) and mark ids by mark declaration order (`builder.rs:96-99`). The macro knows both orders.
- Attribute ids: nodes start at `1` because `NodeSpec::new` seeds the reserved `id` attr (`spec.rs:132-133`) and `.attr` sets `AttrId(self.attrs.len())` (`spec.rs:195-197`); doc/mark attrs start at `0` (`spec.rs:247-249`, `mark.rs:65-67`). Accessor generation must replicate this numbering exactly.
- Runtime resolvers to assert parity: `Schema::node_kind(&str) -> Option<NodeKind>` (`schema/mod.rs:82`), `Schema::mark_id(&str) -> Option<MarkId>` (`mod.rs:88`), `Schema::node(NodeKind)`, `Schema::mark(MarkId)`, `Schema::node_attr(NodeKind, &str)` (`mod.rs:76,94,151`).
- Macro API problem: current expansion is an *expression*. To emit constants it needs an item/scope form (e.g. `schema! { pub mod my_schema { … } }` or `schema! { MySchema; … }`), otherwise repeated invocations collide in the caller module. It must also sanitize/uppercase identifiers and detect collisions (`heading` vs `Heading`).

### 3. Mark recognition and a11y declaration APIs

Mark recognition: `entries.iter().any(|entry| entry.name == "mark")` (`lib.rs:66`), then `expand_mark` (`lib.rs:162-184`). A mark declaration is not marked by keyword `mark` in the block header, only by an entry named `mark`.

A11y runtime API (the exact calls a macro extension must emit):
- `A11ySpec::new(A11yRole) -> A11ySpec` — `a11y/role.rs:153`
- `.with_name(NamePolicy)` — `role.rs:168`; variants `None`, `TextContent`, `Attr(AttrId)`, `Required` — `role.rs:115-124`
- `.with_alt(AltPolicy)` — `role.rs:175`; variants `NotApplicable`, `Optional`, `Required` — `role.rs:128-137`
- `.with_level(AttrId)` — `role.rs:182`; required for `A11yRole::Heading` (`role.rs:21-24,194`)
- Attach with `NodeSpec::a11y` (`spec.rs:204`), `DocSpec::a11y` (`spec.rs:256`), `MarkSpec::a11y` (`mark.rs:74`).
- Roles: `A11yRole` enum incl. `Heading { level: u8 }`, `TableCell { header: bool }`, `Custom(RoleId)` — `role.rs:13-57`.
- `lang`/`dir` are **not** part of `A11ySpec`; they are ordinary doc attributes: `.attr(str_attr("lang"))`, `.attr(enum_attr("dir", &["ltr","rtl","auto"]))` (`full/attrs.rs:7-20`), consumed by the a11y tree.
- Validation is centralized in `validate_a11y`/`validate_doc_a11y` (`builder.rs:168-207`) and `A11ySpec::error_code` (`role.rs:189-203`); the macro should not duplicate it (F24 single-source rule, `plan/03:47`).

### 4. Current tests

`tests/macro_schema.rs:8-35` is the only macro test. It declares `doc`, `paragraph`, `heading` (with `level: int(1..=6) = 1`), `text`, `strong`, `em`, `link` (lines 9-17), then asserts `schema.is_ok()` (18), `node_kind("paragraph")`/`"heading"` exist (22-23), `mark_id("link")` exists (24), heading's `level` attr exists (32-33), and heading content is `"text*"` (34). There are no negative/compile-fail cases and no a11y/accessor assertions.

`tests/schema_support/mod.rs:5-10` contains only `full() -> Option<Schema>` wrapping `Schema::full()`; no macro-specific helpers. A11y/full-schema assertions live in `tests/schema_full.rs:78` (`node.a11y.role == CodeBlock`), `tests/schema_full.rs:82-120` (doc metadata), and `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs`.

### 5. trybuild and dev-dependencies

- `trybuild` is **absent** from `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, crates, `cli`, `Makefile`, and `.github` (grep returned no matches). Workspace dependencies are only `blake3` and `wasm-bindgen` (`Cargo.toml:24-26`).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/Cargo.toml` dev-dependencies: only `rich-editor-auy-macros = { path = "../rich-editor-auy-macros" }` (line 23). Features: only `visits = []` (lines 16-17).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy-macros/Cargo.toml` has no `[dev-dependencies]`; deps are `proc-macro2 = "1"`, `quote = "1"` (lines 19-21), `proc-macro = true` (16-17).

### 6. Compile-fail tests today

None. No `tests/ui/`, no `*.stderr`, no `trybuild`, no `compile_fail` doctests anywhere under `crates/`, `cli/`, `Makefile`, `.github`, `Cargo.toml`, or `Cargo.lock`. Only ordinary integration tests exist (`crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/*.rs`). Note only syntax/unknown-field/unknown-type/bad-literal errors become `compile_error!` (`lib.rs:47-52`); semantic errors (duplicate names, invalid content expression, a11y consistency) surface at runtime via `.build()` (`builder.rs:71-160`), so they need ordinary `Result` tests, not trybuild.

### 7. Documentation of the subset

- Only the macro crate rustdoc documents the form: `crates/rich-editor-auy-macros/src/lib.rs:9-26` (example with `doc`, nodes, `text { inline: true }`, `strong { mark }`, `link { mark, attrs: { href: str } }`).
- README has **no** `schema!` or macro documentation (grep of `README.md` returns no macro mentions).
- `AGENTS.md:18`: "`schema!` é um front-end real (subconjunto documentado)" — but no subset list.
- `plan/04_arquitetura.md:41`: "`rich-editor-auy-macros` | `schema!` e acessores tipados; front-end validado do builder" (typed accessors claimed, not implemented).
- `plan/04_arquitetura.md:56`: "o consumidor a habilita com `features = ["macros"]`" — no such feature exists (`crates/rich-editor-auy/Cargo.toml:16-17`); only a dev-dependency.
- `plan/04_arquitetura.md:671-680` shows the `schema!` sketch; `:694-696` says "a macro e os construtores ainda não existem" (stale).
- `plan/03_decisoes-fechadas.md:60`: D09–D15 ratified "schema runtime + macro".
- `DIVERGENCES.md:60` is the accurate gap statement: "cobre doc/nó/marca/content/group/marks/attrs básicos; sem acessores tipados e sem testes compile-fail … Adicionar a11y declarativa, acessores e `trybuild`; documentar subconjunto".
- `CHANGELOG.md:42-43` records the macro as a real proc-macro for doc/nodes/marks/groups/content/typed attrs.

## Gap list

**(a) Declarative a11y.** Add an `a11y: { ... }` arm to `expand_doc`, `expand_node`, `expand_mark` (`lib.rs:87-184`). Suggested grammar mapping to existing APIs:

```
text    { inline: true, a11y: { role: text, name: text } }
heading { ..., attrs: { level: int(1..=6) = 1 },
          a11y: { role: heading(1), name: text, level: level } }
image   { inline: true, atom: true, attrs: { alt: str required },
          a11y: { role: image, name: attr(alt), alt: required } }
link    { mark, attrs: { href: str required },
          a11y: { role: link, name: text } }
doc     { content: "block+", attrs: { lang: str, dir: enum("ltr","rtl","auto") },
          a11y: { role: document } }
```

Emit `A11ySpec::new(A11yRole::…)` plus `.with_name(NamePolicy::…)`, `.with_alt(AltPolicy::…)`, `.with_level(AttrId(n))`. `level: level` must resolve the declared attr name to the *same* id the builder assigns (node attrs start at 1 per `spec.rs:132-133,195-197`). For `attr(alt)`, resolve to the attr's index. Requires extending `parse_attr_type` for `enum`/`list`/`map` and the attr parser for a `required` marker; `AttrType::Enum(Box<[Box<str>]>)` is at `spec.rs:10-30`, `AttrSpec::required` at `spec.rs:65`. A11y consistency should stay validated by `build()` (`builder.rs:168-207`), not reimplemented in the macro.

**(b) Typed accessors.** Emit, optionally behind a new item-form scope: `pub const PARAGRAPH: NodeKind = NodeKind(i);` (`ids.rs:14`), `pub const LINK: MarkId = MarkId(j);` (`ids.rs:26`), and attr consts with base 1 for nodes / 0 for doc+marks (`spec.rs:195-197,247-249`, `mark.rs:65-67`). Alternatively emit non-const functions calling `Schema::node_kind`/`mark_id` (`mod.rs:82,88`), but that loses compile-time typing. Add parity tests: each const resolves to the right declaration, e.g. `assert_eq!(schema.node_kind("paragraph"), Some(PARAGRAPH))`, and `schema.node(HEADING).attrs.iter().any(|a| a.id == HEADING_LEVEL)`.

**(c) Compile-fail tests.** Add `trybuild = "1"` (dev-dependency in `crates/rich-editor-auy/Cargo.toml`, which already depends on the macro at line 23), a `tests/trybuild.rs` harness, and `tests/ui/*.rs` + `.stderr`. Cover: unknown doc/node/mark field, `marks: "strong"`, unsupported attr type (`float`), malformed `int(1..)`, non-literal default, unknown a11y role/policy after (a). Harness must avoid `unwrap`/`expect` per repo lints; use `let Some(..) = .. else { return }`/`assert!(t.compile_fail("tests/ui/*.rs").is_ok())`.

## Exact APIs to call

- Schema construction: `rich_editor_auy::schema::Schema::builder() -> SchemaBuilder` (`schema/mod.rs:43-46`), `.doc(DocSpec)`, `.node(NodeSpec)`, `.mark(MarkSpec)`, `.build() -> Result<Schema, SchemaError>` (`builder.rs:52-71`).
- Specs: `NodeSpec::new/ content/ group/ inline/ atom/ defining/ isolating/ marks_all/ attr/ a11y`; `MarkSpec::new/ inclusive/ excludes/ attr/ a11y`; `DocSpec::new/ content/ attr/ a11y`; `AttrSpec::new/ required/ with_default` (refs above).
- A11y: `A11ySpec::new/ with_name/ with_alt/ with_level`; `A11yRole` (`role.rs:13-57`); `NamePolicy` (`115-124`); `AltPolicy` (`128-137`); `AttrId::NODE_ID` (`ids.rs:34`).
- Lookup/verification: `Schema::node_kind`, `mark_id`, `node`, `mark`, `node_attr`, `doc`, `nodes`, `marks` (`mod.rs:52-96,151`).
- Macro parsing helpers reusable: `entries`, `single_group`, `split_top_level`, `string_literal`, `bool_literal`, `parse_attr_type`, `parse_default` (`parse.rs:11-166`).

## Risks / constraints

- **300-line src cap**: `lib.rs` is 211 lines and `parse.rs` is 231 lines today; a11y grammar + accessor emission will exceed 300 unless split into modules (e.g. `a11y.rs`, `accessors.rs`, `expand/*.rs`).
- **No new deps**: proc-macro crate must remain `proc-macro2`+`quote` only (`Cargo.toml:19-21`); `trybuild` is std-only dev tooling and belongs in the core crate's dev-deps, not the macro crate.
- **no_std**: generated code uses absolute `::rich_editor_auy` paths and `::core::compile_error!` (`lib.rs:51,77-84,205`), so it stays `no_std`-compatible; all specs/`A11y` are in the `no_std + alloc` core (`src/lib.rs:17-37`). Do not emit `std` paths.
- **Single source of truth (F24, `plan/03:47`)**: do not duplicate a11y/content validation in the macro; emit builder calls and let `build()` validate (`builder.rs:71-160,168-207`).
- **Macro form change**: emitting typed accessors requires a new item/scope syntax and breaks the current expression contract (`tests/macro_schema.rs:9`); decide and migrate the test in the same cutover.
- **Declaration-order coupling**: accessor indices are only valid while node/mark/attr order is unchanged (`builder.rs:80-99`); add parity tests to prevent silent drift.
- **Doc claims**: update `plan/04:41,56,671-696`, `DIVERGENCES.md:60`, and README (currently silent) so the documented subset matches the implementation; `AGENTS.md:18` already promises a documented subset.
- **Mark groups**: `MarkSpec.groups` exists (`mark.rs:16-17`) but no setter; either add `MarkSpec::group()` or leave marks group-less and document it.

## Critical Files for Implementation

- `crates/rich-editor-auy-macros/src/lib.rs` — add `a11y` arms, accessor emission, split expansion modules; current field dispatch at 87-184.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy-macros/src/parse.rs` — extend attr types (`enum`/`list`/`map`), `required` marker, a11y/role token parsing; 231 lines today.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/a11y/role.rs` — `A11yRole`/`A11ySpec`/`NamePolicy`/`AltPolicy` target API and validation semantics.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/schema/spec.rs` — `AttrSpec`/`NodeSpec`/`DocSpec` builder surface, reserved-id and attr-index numbering.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/macro_schema.rs` — extend assertions for a11y/accessors and add `tests/ui` + `tests/trybuild.rs` alongside.
